recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.release/d' -i android/app/build.gradle
flutter_version=3.24.3
git clone https://github.com/Dr-Blank/shelfsdk.git
pushd shelfsdk
git checkout 11a7116ef6ab57e1bf8625fb1c6b40469b6d88d1
popd
git clone -b $flutter_version https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache NO_SIGNING=true
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform="android-arm64"
mv build/app/outputs/apk/release/app-arm64-v8a-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
